import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        Arrays.sort(a);
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        int mx = 0;
        int j = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            while (j < n && a[j] - a[i] <= t) {
                j++;
            }
            mx = Math.max(mx, j - i);
        }
        System.out.println(mx);
        sc.close();
    }
}
